alerts.title: Risk Alerts
alerts.description: Get warned in real time when your trading approaches drawdown limits or shows risky behavior. In-app and email channels.
alerts.drawdown.label: Drawdown warnings
alerts.drawdown.desc: Daily and max drawdown limit warnings for prop firm challenges.
alerts.revenge.label: Revenge trading
alerts.revenge.desc: Detects 3+ trades opened within 15 minutes after a loss.
alerts.overtrading.label: Overtrading
alerts.overtrading.desc: Alert when you exceed your daily trade cap.
alerts.strategy.label: Strategy deviation
alerts.strategy.desc: Notify when you trade symbols outside your active strategies.
alerts.cooldown.label: Cooldown between repeat alerts
alerts.cooldown.desc: How long to wait before the same alert can fire again. Prevents notification spam.
alerts.toast.savedDesc: Your risk-alert preferences have been updated.

psychology.upgradeDesc: Unlock AI-powered psychology analysis to understand how your emotions impact trading results.
psychology.noDataDesc: Tag your trades with mood and mistake categories in the Journal to unlock AI psychology insights.

monthly.eliteDesc: Get AI-generated monthly performance reviews that reflect on your trading journey, highlight improvements, and identify areas for growth.
monthly.noData: No data available for this month
monthly.minTrades: You need at least 5 trades in a month to generate a review
deviation.title: Strategy Deviation Analysis
deviation.eliteDesc: See how rule compliance impacts your trading performance. Compare compliant vs non-compliant trades and identify your most violated rules.
deviation.noDataHint: Validate trades against your strategies to see how rule compliance affects performance
session.title: Session Analytics
session.unlockDesc: Analyze your trading performance by market session. Discover which sessions work best for your strategy.
session.subtitle: Performance by market session
session.noTradeData: No trade data available yet. Start trading to see session analytics.
time.title: Time Patterns
time.unlockDesc: Discover your best trading days and hours. Identify patterns in your performance over time.
time.startTrading: Start trading to see time-based performance patterns
time.subtitle: Performance by Day & Hour (UTC)
diagrams.bullishStructureDesc: Higher Highs (HH) and Higher Lows (HL) define an uptrend
diagrams.bullishStructureCaption: A valid uptrend requires price to make consecutive higher highs and higher lows. A break of a higher low signals potential trend change.
diagrams.orderBlockDesc: Last bearish candle before an impulsive bullish move that breaks structure
diagrams.fvgDesc: Imbalance created when Candle 3's low is above Candle 1's high
diagrams.fvgCaption: Price often returns to fill the FVG before continuing in the original direction. The gap between C1 high and C3 low is the imbalance.
diagrams.liquiditySweepDesc: Institutional move above a swing high to trigger stop losses before reversing
diagrams.bosVsChochDesc: Break of Structure confirms trend; Change of Character signals reversal
diagrams.bosVsChochCaption: BOS: Price breaks the previous swing high/low in the direction of the trend. CHoCH: Price breaks the previous swing high/low against the trend, signaling a shift.
diagrams.candlePatternsDesc: Single and multi-candle reversal patterns used for confirmation
diagrams.sessionsDesc: Major trading sessions and their overlap periods
diagrams.riskRewardDesc: Proper trade setup with defined stop loss and take profit levels
diagrams.riskRewardCaption: Minimum 1:2 R:R recommended. With 1:3 R:R, you only need a 25% win rate to break even.
diagrams.breakerBlockDesc: A failed order block that becomes support/resistance on the opposite side
